title: The Giants That Were Mills
readingBoundary: Part I chapter 8, windmills through Sancho's meal on the road; classroom-sequence finale, not novel ending
openingPromise: Travel beside Sancho, try to make a warning heard, and witness how disagreement and care survive a disastrous charge.
harmon: You: curious witness wants to understand courage
Go: one-question journal brings student to La Mancha
Search: compare giants and mills; try a warning
Find: Quixote charges with absolute certainty
Take: broken lance, injured rider and horse; certainty survives
Return: Sancho helps, argues and jokes; journal returns student
Change: courage includes warning, evidence and practical care
choices: Ask for evidence / ask about fortune
Sancho explains function / Quixote explains his mission
Call out physical evidence / ask for a pause
Sancho repeats concrete warning / plea to listen
Make space / right is less useful than heard
Challenge timing / ask why explanation matters
Belief absorbs objection / motive becomes clear
Question books as orders / ask about island
Practical use versus script / hope and bodily needs
sceneTrim: Focus on encounter and immediate recovery; omit later night and friar encounter. Keep Sancho's accurate perception, desire for reward, help and humour together. No invented redemption or renunciation by Quixote.
fixedEvents: Listed in sources.json; exhaustive test covers 64 routes.
animation: New reusable mounted-charge, wince and steady actions. Horse, saddle, buckler and rider are runtime vectors; all episode character identities reused. No new runtime command grammar. Charge does not simulate contact or a fall; cut, shake and caption handle these, followed by low aftermath staging.

background.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: 16:9 visual-novel background for Don Quixote's windmill encounter. A wide sunlit plain in La Mancha, Spain, early seventeenth century. Whitewashed cylindrical windmills with dark conical roofs and four wooden lattice sails; one prominent mill in the right third, other smaller mills receding across a low distant ridge. Broad open ochre dirt foreground in the left and center, unobstructed, for animated characters and a horse. Dry grasses at frame edges, pale blue sky, gentle hills. Clean dark slate linework, warm cream and muted ochre colours, restrained cel shading, simplified manga-inspired graphic-novel scenery matching polished SVG figures. Eye-level camera, full landscape frame, readable silhouettes, background less contrasted than actors. No people, no horses, no giants, no modern turbines, no lettering, no captions, no border, no photorealism.
